I removed the withdrawn "at least one resource must remain unallocated" rule from `src/solution.py`. I didn't run it or write any checks.

Before, the function returned `False` when every resource type was fully used. Now it returns `True` whenever no resource type's total request exceeds its capacity. That covers the case where the total exactly matches capacity (ac_5).

I left everything else as it was, including the input validation and the function signature. I did not revisit whether the existing "Resources cannot be empty" error is still needed.
